answer: Final p-value (primary analysis, record-level 2×2 Pearson chi-square without Yates continuity correction): **p = 2.95 × 10⁻⁷²** (chi² = 323.1721, df = 1, N = 12,754). m6A methylation status and differential expression status are strongly non-independent (associated) in the bladder cancer dataset: m6A-significant records are enriched for differential expression (246/1,191 = 20.7% DEG vs 717/11,563 = 6.2% among m6A-non-significant records; odds ratio ≈ 3.94). Sensitivity analyses agree: Yates-corrected χ² p = 8.32×10⁻⁷², Fisher exact p = 8.22×10⁻⁵⁴, 3×3 (Hyper/Hypo/no-sig × Up/Down/no-DEG) χ² p = 8.10×10⁻¹⁹⁴, gene-level collapsed 2×2 (n=3,117 genes) χ² p = 9.63×10⁻¹⁹ — all far below any conventional threshold. Primary deliverable: p ≈ 2.95e-72.
